title: Strawberries in plastic tunnel: 126 / 18 / 18 kg of polyethylene disposal per kg of fruit
observation: 126.22 / 18.085 / 18.079 kg `Disposal, polyethylene, 0.4% water, to municipal incineration` per kg fruit, against 0.0096 / 0.042 / 0.036 kg of polyethylene granulate entering; the tunnel film is already disposed of in the tunnel dataset (per m²·a). The LCIA workbook scores them at 383 / 55 / 55 kg CO₂-eq per kg; the heated greenhouse in the same group scores 2.6. Identical in both releases; not in the 2026 change log. BAFU confirmed the error by email on 12 October 2026 and announced a correction for its next release; community-fixes [patch 0001](https://github.com/sentier-dev/bafu-community-fixes/blob/053c799a4d3e129747f47d6775ea88647c0bec78/src/bafu_community_fixes/patches/p0001_strawberry_polyethylene_disposal.py) applies the corrected amounts until then.

provider_response.public_summary: Confirmed the error and gave the corrected amounts, which equal each dataset's own polyethylene granulate input; to be corrected in the next release.

validation_scope: Re-measured on the release files; the patch stops if a dataset does not carry the expected amount.
next_action: Verify the corrected amounts in the next BAFU release; then mark upstream-fixed and retire patch 0001.

retained.text: An earlier mass-balance framing of the finding was wrong and was corrected.
